agents.title: Agent Help
agents.subtitle: How agents work with this kit: Read the guide first. Then build. Many things already exist as a building block.
agents.orientationP1: The design system is the set of all building blocks: containers, boxes, cards, progress displays, a quiz, a tooltip. Each building block has exactly one guide. People and agents read the same file. The gallery shows exactly this file. So there are never two versions.
agents.englishNote: The guides are in English on purpose. One version for people and agents. Nothing can drift apart.
agents.indexLede: Find your task. Then open the linked guides. The table is built automatically from the list of building blocks. Each building block is in exactly one row.
agents.indexSummary: {count} building blocks in {groups} groups. The table is built automatically from the list. You can also find all blocks in the gallery.
agents.loopLede: An automatic check watches every new building block. Follow these steps. The command /new-component helps you.
agents.step1Body: Is there a building block that almost fits? Then stop. Use the existing one. Do not build a copy.
agents.step2Title: Ask: will it be used often?
agents.step2Body: Will the building block be used in many places? Then it goes on the list. Used only once? Then it goes in the exceptions file. With a short reason.
agents.step3Body: The component file, the list entry, the guide, and a live example. Once it is on the list, it appears automatically in the gallery and in the table above.
agents.step4Body: Run both checks. Both must pass:
agents.ctaBody: The command /new-component does all of this the right way. The writing rules are in: docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.MD.

guides.agentsTitle: Guides for questions about parts and layouts
guides.agentsLede: Do you have a question about Optimus UI parts, about basics, or about layouts? Then the guides help. Each guide has one agent guide. Read in small steps: the list first. Then one part. Then the whole guide only if you need it.
